metadata.title: An overview of energy management system (ISO 50001) with its implementation plan

eligibility.methodological_eligibility.quote: Based on the energy profile and baseline data gathered for almost one year, EnPIs for different departments would be established. EnPIs are a quantitative index of energy performance as defined by the organization.
eligibility.methodological_eligibility.rule: §5.2 limiar inclusivo + ROTA BORDERLINE: caracteriza mensurando e (c) abordagem de construcao, mas nunca especifica variaveis ou forma funcional, pelo que a caracterizacao genuina e discutivel.
